description: The Kansas National Education Association through its Kansas Political Action Committee announced the recommendation of Sen. Cindy Holscher for governor of Kansas. Holscher, a longtime champion for Kansas public schools in the state legislature, has made strengthening public education a central part of her campaign for governor.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: Kansas Political Action Committee Recommends Cindy Holscher in Governor’s Race | Cindy Holscher for Governor
